description: Your own habits printed into a monthly habit tracker: the real days of each month with weekday letters, shaded weekends, a daily goal column, 1/3/6/12 months (one landscape page each), optional mood row and monthly review box, 12 languages, A4 or US Letter. Optional Excel version that turns a day green when marked and counts done days, % and best streak by itself. For wellness apps, coaching tools, journals and New Year resolution campaigns.
